jobs.description:

jobs.title: Senior Security Penetration Tester
jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Security Penetration Tester - Web, API, Thick Client & AWS

Experience: 7 to 12 Years

Location: Pune & Hyderabad

Job Function: Information Security / Cybersecurity

Specialization: Application Security & Penetration Testing

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Penetration Tester with 7 to 12 years of hands-on experience in manual security testing of Web Applications, APIs, Thick Client/Desktop Applications, Mobile Applications, and AWS Cloud environments.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in identifying complex security vulnerabilities, conducting advanced penetration testing, triaging Bug Bounty and Vulnerability Disclosure Program (VDP) submissions, developing Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and providing effective remediation guidance.

Key Responsibilities & Required Skills

1. Manual Security Penetration Testing
• Conduct manual penetration testing of Web Applications and APIs hosted in on-premises and cloud environments.
• Perform security assessments of AWS services, including S3, EC2, Lambda, API Gateway, SNS, and other cloud components.
• Conduct Thick Client/Desktop Application security testing using reverse engineering techniques.
• Perform security testing of mobile applications.

2. Thick Client Security Testing & Reverse Engineering

Hands-on experience with tools such as:
• IDA Pro, Ghidra
• dnSpy, DotPeek
• Echo Mirage, CFF Explorer
• Microsoft Sysinternals
• Wireshark

3. VDP & Bug Bounty Triage
• Strong experience in triaging Vulnerability Disclosure Program (VDP) and Bug Bounty reports.
• Technically validate external security researcher submissions.
• Assess vulnerability impact, severity, and exploitability.
• Ensure fair and consistent evaluation based on program policies and security standards.

4. Vulnerability Assessment & Risk Management
• Strong understanding of CVSS scoring methodology and vulnerability risk assessment.
• Excellent knowledge of OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25, and common application security vulnerabilities.
• Understand vulnerable programming patterns and recommend appropriate remediation techniques.

5. Exploitation, PoCs & Remediation
• Think creatively to identify complex vulnerabilities and attack scenarios.
• Develop impactful Proof of Concepts (PoCs) to demonstrate security issues.
• Conduct vulnerability walkthroughs with application development teams.
• Provide actionable remediation recommendations and security improvement guidance.

6. Tools & Technologies
• Strong hands-on experience with Burp Suite, Postman, OWASP ZAP, and Kali Linux.
• Experience using advanced security testing tools and methodologies.
• Understanding of AWS cloud security and application security testing.

Technical Qualifications
• 7 to 12 years of hands-on experience in application security and penetration testing.
• Strong experience in Web Application, Web API, Thick Client, Mobile Application, and AWS security testing.
• Experience in the Banking / Financial Services domain is preferred.
• Excellent technical documentation, reporting, and communication skills.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
• Ability to mentor and guide junior team members and share knowledge of emerging attack techniques.

Good to Have
• Experience in security testing of AI-based applications.
• Experience with AWS serverless architectures and microservices.
• AWS Cloud Practitioner or other AWS certifications.
• Security certifications such as CEH, CPENT, or equivalent.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is passionate about application security, possesses strong manual penetration testing capabilities, has an analytical mindset, and can independently identify, validate, demonstrate, and help remediate complex security vulnerabilities.

If you have the relevant experience and expertise, we would love to connect with you!

jobs.title: Cyber Operate- Crowd Strike - Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
Summary

Position Summary

As an experienced Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.

• Oversee governance, vendor management, service performance, and strategic improvements across automation, threat hunting, exposure reduction, and reporting.

Deloitte’s Endpoint Security Operate teams manage clients’ endpoint security environments either as a fully managed service or in partnership with client teams. Our flexible and modularized methodology has been utilized by numerous global organizations to build a broad global privacy, data protection, and/or digital trust operations and includes the following phases and activities.

• Incident response

• Certifications such as ITIL Foundation, CEH, CompTIA Security+, CISSP, GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst, or GMON

jobs.title: Alternate Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM)
jobs.description:
Applied Research Associates (ARA), Inc. has an immediate need for an early-career Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) in Raleigh, NC. This role will provide day-to-day cybersecurity oversight for multiple classified information systems, with primary emphasis on a SIPRNet environment connected to the DoDIN and associated contractual cybersecurity requirements. The position is focused on maintaining secure, authorized, and inspection-ready operations across assigned DCSA/DoW environments. The Alternate ISSM will support RMF/ATO maintenance, eMASS administration, continuous monitoring, vulnerability and audit compliance, assessment readiness, and coordination technical stakeholders while reporting to the Senior ISSM/Cybersecurity Team Manager.

Alternate Information Systems Security Manager Primary Responsibilities

• Serve as an Alternate ISSM for assigned classified systems and maintain day-to-day cybersecurity compliance, authorization readiness, and risk visibility.
• Support Risk Management Framework (RMF) and Authorization to Operate (ATO) lifecycle activities, including system categorization, control implementation and assessment support, authorization package maintenance, and continuous monitoring.
• Develop, review, and maintain cybersecurity documentation including System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Plans/Reports, POA&Ms, risk assessments and acceptances, continuous monitoring records, inventory, network diagrams, ports/protocols/services documentation, and supporting evidence.
• Administer and quality-check eMASS records, control implementation statements, artifacts, assessment results, inherited controls, deficiencies, risk decisions, and authorization documentation.
• Maintain assessment and inspection readiness; support DCSA, DoW, customer, and other Government cybersecurity reviews, annual self-assessments, and corrective-action activities.
• Review system changes through configuration/change-control processes, assess security impact, and ensure approved changes are reflected in baselines, inventories, diagrams, and RMF artifacts.
• Coordinate routine cybersecurity matters with technical teams and other mission partners; elevate significant risk or resource issues to the Senior ISSM.
• Support development and maintenance of overarching DCSA cybersecurity policies, procedures, templates, and common documentation as assigned by the Senior ISSM.
• Support incidents, urgent vulnerabilities, emergency patching, outages affecting security controls, and Government-directed cybersecurity actions when required.

Alternate Information Systems Security Manager Qualifications

• US Citizen with an active DoD Secret clearance; SCI eligibility preferred.
• Bachelor’s (or equivalent) with 5 – 7 yrs. of experience, or a Master’s and 3 to 5 yrs. of experience; equivalent directly relevant experience may be considered in leu of degrees.
• 5+ years of supporting cybersecurity, information assurance, information systems security, or related IT environments, including experience supporting classified Government systems.
• 2+ years of experience performing ISSM, senior ISSO/IA, or comparable cybersecurity leadership responsibilities.
• Experience supporting DoD RMF and DCSA authorization processes, with familiarity with DoDM/DoDI directive, NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 4 and Rev. 5, 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM), and continuous monitoring requirements.
• Hands-on experience with eMASS or a comparable Government governance-risk-compliance platform.
• Experience with vulnerability and configuration-compliance tools and processes such as ACAS/Tenable, STIGs, SCAP, SIEM/log review, patch management, and remediation tracking.
• Ability to meet DoD 8750/DoD 8140 cybersecurity workforce qualification requirements applicable to the assigned ISSM/IAM work role.
• Demonstrated ability to communicate technical risk, authorization status, deficiencies, and resource needs to technical staff, program leadership, and Government stakeholders.

Alternate Information Systems Security Manager Preferences

• Direct experience supporting SIPRNet or other DoDIN-connected classified environments.
• Experience preparing for or supporting CORA, security control assessments, DCSA reviews, or comparable Government cybersecurity assessments.
• Advanced cybersecurity certification or another DoD-approved credential appropriate to the assigned work role.
• Experience with Splunk or another SIEM, ACAS/Tenable Security Center, Windows and Linux security baselines, virtualization, Active Directory/Group Policy, and network-security technologies.
• Experience leading or coordinating cross-functional cybersecurity teams that include ISSOs, security engineers, system administrators, and program personnel.

Who is ARA?

Do you want to work for a purpose? Applied Research Associates, Inc. (aka ARA) is an employee-owned international research and engineering company. We have been providing technically superior solutions to complex and challenging problems in the physical sciences since 1979. ARA has over 2,279 employee owners and continues to grow rapidly. Together, our offices throughout the U.S. and Canada provide a broad range of technical expertise in defense, civil, and health technologies, computer software and simulation, systems analysis, environmental technologies, and testing and measurement.

ARA also prides itself, on having a challenging culture where innovation & experimentation are the norm. The motto, “Engineering and Science for Fun and Profit” sums up the ARA experience. Employee ownership ensures you have a voice with what happens in the company.

To find out more about what the Integrated Mission Systems Sector has to offer, visit our website at https://www.ara.com/raleigh/

To learn more about our generous benefits program including health, life & disability, retirement, flexible spending, rewards & recognition, work/life balance, professional development and relocation visit https://www.ara.com/benefits/

jobs.title: Cybersecurity  Consultant
jobs.description:
Cybersecurity Consultant

Location: UAE (UAE presence preferred)

Experience: 4–6 years

Contract Duration: 6 months, extendable based on performance

Role Overview

We are looking for an IT Risk & Controls Consultant with experience in IT audits, IT General Controls (ITGC), and cybersecurity assurance. The candidate will assess IT controls, evaluate compliance with security frameworks, identify control gaps, and recommend improvements to strengthen the organization's internal control environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct ITGC audits covering user access management, change management, IT operations, and program development controls.
• Perform cybersecurity assessments against NIST CSF, ISO 27001, UAE IA, and DESC ISR frameworks.
• Test the design and operating effectiveness of IT controls.
• Review Information Produced by the Entity (IPE) and assess reliance on SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports.
• Identify control deficiencies, document audit findings, and coordinate remediation with IT and business stakeholders.
• Assess internal controls in line with COSO, COBIT, and ICFR/SOX requirements.
• Prepare audit reports, supporting evidence, and recommendations for control improvements.

Required Skills And Qualifications

• 4–6 years of experience in IT audit, ITGC testing, IT risk, or cybersecurity assurance.
• Hands-on experience with IT General Controls testing.
• Knowledge of NIST CSF, ISO 27001, UAE IA, or DESC ISR.
• Understanding of Test of Design (TOD) and Test of Operating Effectiveness (TOE).
• Familiarity with COSO, COBIT, and ICFR/SOX.
• CISA and/or DISA certification is mandatory.
• Strong analytical, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Good to Have

• Experience working with Big 4 consulting or audit firms.
• ERP exposure, including SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics.
• Additional certifications such as CISM, CRISC, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer, CEH, or CIA.
• Previous UAE client or regional compliance experience.

Contract Details

• Four-month initial contract, with potential extension based on performance.
• UAE presence preferred.

jobs.title: Data Protection Consultant
jobs.description:
Role Summary
• We are looking for an experienced Data Protection Consultant with strong hands-on experience in the Varonis Data Security Platform to manage and enhance a customer’s data protection and Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) program.
• The role will work closely with security, infrastructure, IAM, compliance and business stakeholders to identify sensitive data, understand access and permissions, monitor data activity, remediate exposure and continuously improve the customer’s data-security posture.

Key Responsibilities
• Manage and operate the Varonis Data Security Platform on a day-to-day basis.
• Perform sensitive-data discovery and classification across enterprise data repositories.
• Identify overexposed sensitive information, excessive access and stale permissions.
• Drive least-privilege access through permissions review, cleanup and remediation.
• Monitor data-access activity and investigate anomalous or suspicious behavior.
• Investigate potential insider threats, compromised accounts, abnormal downloads and data-exfiltration risks.
• Configure and tune Varonis policies, alerts, classification rules and reporting.
• Implement policy-based and automated remediation where appropriate.
• Support security investigations and integration with SOC, SIEM and SOAR processes.
• Develop dashboards and periodic reporting on data exposure, sensitive-data risks, alerts and remediation status.
• Maintain operational documentation, SOPs and remediation trackers.
• Conduct periodic data-security posture reviews and work with stakeholders to remediate risks without affecting legitimate business access.

Required Experience & Skills
• Minimum 3+ years of overall experience in cybersecurity, information security or data protection.
• Preferably 2+ years of hands-on Varonis experience.
• Practical knowledge of Varonis, DSPM, data discovery and classification, access governance, permissions, data activity monitoring, UEBA, threat investigation and remediation.
• Strong understanding of Active Directory / Entra ID, users, groups, permissions and identity-based access.
• Experience with Windows file shares, SharePoint/SharePoint Online, Microsoft 365 and cloud/SaaS data repositories.
• Understanding of DLP, data governance, data privacy and information-protection concepts.
• Familiarity with SIEM/SOC and incident-response processes.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation and customer-facing communication skills.

Preferred Skills
• Microsoft Purview Information Protection / DLP.
• Microsoft 365 and SharePoint security.
• Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory.
• Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk or an equivalent SIEM platform.
• Exposure to other DLP/data-security technologies such as Forcepoint, Broadcom/Symantec, Trellix or Imperva.
• Understanding of ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR and UAE data-protection requirements.

The key expectation is a consultant who can combine hands-on operational capability with a broader understanding of data protection, DSPM, access governance and customer engagement.
